title: The residue-field map of an unramified finite-type morphism is etale
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a formally unramified, locally finite type morphism of schemes [def-weil-etale-morphism], [def-pc-scheme] and $x\in X$. The induced ring map $\kappa(f(x))\to\kappa(x)$ [def-weil-residue-field] is etale. In particular this applies to every etale structural morphism of a neighbourhood over a field.
